$comment: Lightweight orchestration for pico-spatial-app-designer. The host LLM is the orchestrator; there is no Python gate, no execution-trace receipts, no status state machine. Reasoning is carried in design-doc.md (copied from references/design-doc-template.md). Phases run in order; the critique-again phase drives a bounded patch loop.

phases.title: Frame
phases.does: Anchor subject (domain, viewer, room/posture, single job); justify space affordance-by-affordance with a 2D counterfactual for each core task, letting that justification pick the form and scale (Planar window of any size / HUD-Augment widget / Volumetric / Stage); capture assumptions with confidence.

phases.title: Explore
phases.does: Generate >=3 substantially different design directions, preferably via one fresh-context subagent per direction spawned in parallel (each seeded only with shared frame/job/spatial-justification/domain plus one divergence constraint, blind to the others); fall back to isolated inline generation if subagents are unavailable. Then, as orchestrator, discard near-duplicates, compare in a decision matrix, pick one, and record why the others lost.
phases.output: Three alternatives + decision matrix + chosen direction + rejection reasons

phases.title: Plan
phases.does: Compact named system: a complete 16-role ColorScheme plus brand tokens, type pairing, SpatialUI glass/material choices, signature element, final per-surface default/min/max dimensions, layout with ASCII wireframes, state graph, components with data source + task, and a SpatialUI Web map for every standard control/system surface. Scene-tier, clear-FOV, and sizing-chain calculations remain internal and are not copied into the deliverable.
phases.output: Complete theme contract + final surface dimensions + layout + state graph + components + SpatialUI Web component map

phases.title: Critique (before build)
phases.does: Simulate the generic-default output for this brief; check the plan for templated thinking; run originality and spatial hard checks; revise and note changes. Gate before building.

phases.title: Build
phases.does: Fill the product coverage manifest from the plan, then build a single self-contained preview.html: inline the vendored SpatialUI Web bundle, preserve its vibrant scheme and Material.Regular glass root, install all 16 ColorScheme roles through PicoTheme, render mapped sui-* controls wired through public events, and implement a triggerable state machine with real/fallback/error data, SpatialUI high-risk dialogs, and natural CSS reflow. Do not expose viewport presets or other design/debug controls in the product UI.

phases.title: Critique again
phases.does: Independently rebuild the coverage list from design-doc.md; verify each product state/transition/component/data binding is implemented and testable; audit SpatialUI bundle embedding, Material.Regular glass, complete theme installation, tag registration, public-event wiring, native-control duplicates, natural viewport reflow, and absence of design/debug-only controls; check against the quality bar; drive the bounded patch loop.
